title: Web client: contact management (add, block/unblock, open chat)
description:
kithd should auto-discover all kithd-running peers on the tailnet and add them as contacts. The server probes every tailnet peer IP at startup and periodically; any IP that responds to GET /.well-known/jmap with a kith session is added as a contact. The web client then shows contacts without any manual input. Block/unblock UI is needed because auto-add means every tailnet peer gets added.

Scope:
1. kithd JMAP session: expose ownerTailscaleUserId and ownerLogin in /.well-known/jmap so probing identifies the owner
2. kithd: peer probe client — HTTP client accepting self-signed certs from tailnet IPs, GET /.well-known/jmap, parse response
3. kithd: discovery background task — at startup + every N minutes, LocalAPI /status → probe each peer IP → upsert contact
4. kith-store: upsert_discovered_contact — idempotent (preserves user-set displayName; updates mailboxHost on discovery)
5. Web client: EventSource Contact subscription + re-render on Contact state change
6. Web client: block/unblock toggle on each contact row in renderContactList
